pk: vakyarTadipika (sri.wi.) ityuktaniti ‘taTa hi- atatvanasiti navakrtva upadesa sadrswantaka’ iti pratijnatani-tyarTa upapaditaniti na hi sakunisutrayorityaraByEtavata granTenetyarTa arTEkatveti ‘arTEkatvadekan vakyan’ iti jEninisutradityarTa nanu kaTananenoktaviroDaparihara ityata aha- gunotkarsa iti BavasaDana iti Bavo DatvarTa tan saDayati pratipadayatiti BavasaDana ityarTa karanasaDana iti karanatvapratipadaka ityarTa tadarTyeneti BedasidDyarTatvenetyarTa vastuparyaya iti aBiDeyarTaka ityarTa svaparasaDarana iti svaparaBiDayaka ityarTa nanu svasabdaprayogena kaTanitarasarvavyavrtiboDa ityata uktan- sidDe (sri.wi.) satiti svaparasaDaranarupasabdenEva svasnin sidDe prapte sati punararanBo niyanarTa, svasabdena puna pratipadanan svaKyaneva rupan aBiDeyaniti niyanarTanityarTa evan ca svasabda svetarasanastavastuvyavrtin pratipadayatiti Bava nanvitarasarvavyavrtiboDanaya yadi svasabda prayujyate tarhi svarupasabdantargatasya svasabdasya vyavrtyarTakatvaneva praptan tatkaTan vyavrtavastuvacakatvan taTa ca sarvato vyavrtan rupan svarupanityuktanasadityata aha - Darnavacanananiti evan ca vyavrtirupaDarnavacyapi sabdo vyavrtavasturupaDarnyaBiDayakopi Bavati DarnaDarninoraBedaditi Bava nanu svasabdasya vyavrtyarTakatvepi vyavrtisca svarupatetyuktan vyavrtisvarupatayorEkyan kaTan praptanityatastadupa-padayati- pravrtininitaneva ceti ‘tasya BavastvatalO’ iti sutroktatvatalpratyayarupatadDitavacyo Darna sabdasya yatpravrtininitan tadeva yaTa Gawatvadi evan ca prakrte rupasabdasanaBivyahrtasvasabdapravrtininitaButEva vyavrti, svarupatetyatra svarupasya Bava svarupateti tadDita(Buta)svarupatalpratyayavacyo Darna iti tayorBeda-BavadvyavrtisvarupatayorEkyanityarTa nanu vyavrtisvarupatayorEkyepi visnusvarupavyavrtyo kaTanEkya-nityata aha- na catreti taTa ca DarnaDarninoraBedadBagavadDarnaButavyavrtiBagavatsvarupayorEkyaniti Bava nanu BagavatsvarupavyavrtyorEkye Bagavatasarvasnadvyavrtiriti DarnaDarniBavayoga ityata aha- kevala-niti dviviDe vyavrtirupe vyavartakaDarnarupe ca nanu BedakaDarnavyavrtyorvisnusvarupenaBede svatantryadiguna-visisve sarvavyavrtya ca visisve harO tatparyanityetana yuktan tasyaBedasapeksatvadityata aha- visesaviva-ksayaniti aBede Bedakaryakarivisesavivaksayeti yavadityarTa uBayaviDeti vyavrtivyavartakaDarna-rupoBayaviDetyarTa evasabdeneti neti netityadika sruti sarvavyavrtataneva visnorvadati na tu kinapi jaganastiti sarvasatvan pratipadayatityevan sarvasatvavaditvan evasabdena vyavartayatityarTa
ck: vakyartatipika (sri.ti.) ityuktaniti ‘tata hi- atatvanasiti navakrtva upatesa satrstantaka’ iti praticnatani-tyarta upapatitaniti na hi sakunisutrayorityarapyEtavata krantenetyarta artEkatveti ‘artEkatvatekan vakyan’ iti cEninisutratityarta nanu katananenoktavirotaparihara ityata aha- kunotkarsa iti pavasatana iti pavo tatvarta tan satayati pratipatayatiti pavasatana ityarta karanasatana iti karanatvapratipataka ityarta tatartyeneti petasityartatvenetyarta vastuparyaya iti apiteyartaka ityarta svaparasatarana iti svaparapitayaka ityarta nanu svasaptaprayokena katanitarasarvavyavrtipota ityata uktan- site (sri.ti.) satiti svaparasataranarupasaptenEva svasnin site prapte sati punararanpo niyanarta, svasaptena puna pratipatanan svakyaneva rupan apiteyaniti niyanartanityarta evan ca svasapta svetarasanastavastuvyavrtin pratipatayatiti pava nanvitarasarvavyavrtipotanaya yati svasapta prayucyate tarhi svarupasaptantarkatasya svasaptasya vyavrtyartakatvaneva praptan tatkatan vyavrtavastuvacakatvan tata ca sarvato vyavrtan rupan svarupanityuktanasatityata aha - tarnavacanananiti evan ca vyavrtirupatarnavacyapi sapto vyavrtavasturupatarnyapitayakopi pavati tarnatarninorapetatiti pava nanu svasaptasya vyavrtyartakatvepi vyavrtisca svarupatetyuktan vyavrtisvarupatayorEkyan katan praptanityatastatupa-patayati- pravrtininitaneva ceti ‘tasya pavastvatalO’ iti sutroktatvatalpratyayarupatatitavacyo tarna saptasya yatpravrtininitan tateva yata katatvati evan ca prakrte rupasaptasanapivyahrtasvasaptapravrtininitaputEva vyavrti, svarupatetyatra svarupasya pava svarupateti tatita(puta)svarupatalpratyayavacyo tarna iti tayorpeta-pavatvyavrtisvarupatayorEkyanityarta nanu vyavrtisvarupatayorEkyepi visnusvarupavyavrtyo katanEkya-nityata aha- na catreti tata ca tarnatarninorapetatpakavatarnaputavyavrtipakavatsvarupayorEkyaniti pava nanu pakavatsvarupavyavrtyorEkye pakavatasarvasnatvyavrtiriti tarnatarnipavayoka ityata aha- kevala-niti tvivite vyavrtirupe vyavartakatarnarupe ca nanu petakatarnavyavrtyorvisnusvarupenapete svatantryatikuna-visisve sarvavyavrtya ca visisve harO tatparyanityetana yuktan tasyapetasapeksatvatityata aha- visesaviva-ksayaniti apete petakaryakarivisesavivaksayeti yavatityarta upayaviteti vyavrtivyavartakatarna-rupopayavitetyarta evasapteneti neti netityatika sruti sarvavyavrtataneva visnorvatati na tu kinapi cakanastiti sarvasatvan pratipatayatityevan sarvasatvavatitvan evasaptena vyavartayatityarta
s: वाक्यार्थदीपिका (श्री.टि.) इत्युक्तमिति ‘तथा हि- अतत्त्वमसीति नवकृत्व उपदेशः सदृष्टान्तकः’ इति प्रतिज्ञातमि-त्यर्थः उपपादितमिति न हि शकुनिसू
